status: rehearsal candidate, not a product pin
why_this_candidate: The latest published tag of https://github.com/tonioni/WinUAE is 6030 (the pin). Every later change is on master. WinUAE publishes its betas as commits whose subject is the version (6100b1 .. 6100b17); the newest one is the candidate. It is a full commit SHA fetched explicitly (git fetch --depth=1 <sha>), not a branch name, and nothing in the product refers to master.
version_string: 6.1.0 public beta 17 (include/winuae_version.h: UAEMAJOR 6, UAEMINOR 1, UAESUBREV 0, WINUAEBETA 17)
author: Toni Wilen

scope_old_to_new.release_notes: od-win32/winuaechangelog.txt of the candidate, sections Beta 1 .. Beta 17 (6.1.0). Beta 17 is dated 2026-10-12, the day it was fetched (b16 is 2026-09-27), so it has had no field time.
notes_that_matter_to_the_profile: Beta 10: AGA Lisa bitplane/sprite shifters always 64-bit (drawing.cpp, bpldat_docopy simplified, FMODE64_HACK line-to-screen includes removed).
Beta 13: cycle-exact event handling optimized, blitter-stuck handling rewritten (no more event every 10 CCKs), Copper COPJMPx/pending-move conflicts reimplemented, CIA/Denise fixes.
Beta 14: native-mode vertical blank start/end detection reworked (linear_* variables, display_last_* removed), Copper bugs reimplemented for 6.1, state saves current floppy speed.
Beta 16: Paula DMAL serial line / Agnus DMAL shift register emulated cycle-accurately; UHRES; lost sync states; non-CE blitter speed fix.

Beta 17: CIA-A TOD VSync and CIA-B TOD HSync counting moved to the v6+ hsync/vsync check routines; 'Statefile save didn't always save correct RGA pipeline slots'; OCS Denise BURST/BPL1DAT hidden feature; remove-interlace-artifacts option; horizontal centering.

how_it_was_obtained: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 <repository> <commit> into a bare repository under build/update/ of the rehearsal worktree; blobs read with tools/import_sources.py blobs() (Git objects, not a checkout); nothing from it was executed on the host except what the project builds from source.
